During this part of the meeting, members of the Commission report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports required by AB 1234. In addition, consensus may be given to refer potential initiatives, policies, programs, or projects to the City Council, for City Council direction on whether to have the Commission review and advise on such initiative, policy, program, or project at a future Commission meeting.
